content:
CustomMade replayer - provenance

Exilum Player's CustomMade decoder (renderer/src/main/cpp/custommade) is a C++
port of the routine that plays Ron Klaren's music: Ivo Zoer's replay routine
(1989-90), as adapted for Eagleplayer by Andy Silva and Wanted Team
(CustomMade_v1.asm).

Neither the original routine nor the Eagleplayer adaptation states a licence.
The port is distributed as part of Exilum Player under the GNU GPL v3 or later,
without any claim over the original authors' work.
